text:
Jenna (Product): Thanks everyone for the all-hands. Quick follow-up Qs on shipping cadence for API, Console GA, and Optimize beta — trying to map dependencies for customer comms. TL;DR: when can we commit to feature windows (API stable / Console GA / Optimize beta)? cc @Marco @Priya
Marco (CEO): Short answer: API stable target end of Q2, Console GA early Q3, Optimize beta late Q3. Need to lock weeks after we get final engineering sign-off.
Priya (Eng Lead): Agree high level. Note: the quantization & perf sweep for Optimize needs ~2 sprints after model partner sign-off. If partner sign-off is by May 10, beta target around Aug 20.
Alex (PM): Can we get firm canary dates? Customers asked for a one-week canary before Console GA. Also: is there a migration script for existing dashboards?
Priya (Eng Lead): Proposed canary for Console: week of Jul 8-12. Lina, can you confirm devex migration script status?
Lina (DevEx): Working on it. PR: https://git.internal/r/devex/console-migrate — tests failing on export/import edge cases. ETA to green: Jun 14. Will post CI updates.
Sam (SRE): From infra side, Dedicated capacity ramp requires reservations by Jun 20 to hit the Jul canary. ops-bot, please open ticket for capacity reservation.
ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-4821 - Reserved capacity for Console canary. Assignees: @Sam, @InfraOps.
Jenna (Product): For external comms, marketing needs an "early access" blurb for Optimize beta. Marco, can you approve copy by Jun 25?
Marco (CEO): :thumbsup: Yes. PMs should send suggested copy to marketing by Jun 18.
Alex (PM): I'll draft a one-pager with canary plan, fallback behaviors, and known limitations. Any SLO changes required for API stable? @Sam
Sam (SRE): API stable SLO: keep 99.9% p95 latency target. Token-cost thresholds unchanged. I'll draft an ops runbook and post it to #eng-oncall by Jun 20.
Priya (Eng Lead): One risk to call out: runtime v2 model back-compat. If we rollback to fallback model it adds ~150ms tail latency. Include that in customer-facing notes.
Jenna (Product): Great. Action items: Alex -> one-pager by Jun 12; Priya -> confirm partner sign-off date; Lina -> green PR by Jun 14; Sam -> reserve capacity ticket + runbook by Jun 20; Marco -> approve marketing copy by Jun 25. I'll schedule a follow-up sync next Wed. :calendar:
Jenna (Product): Thanks all — appreciate the quick takes. I'll post a short summary doc and tag relevant folks.
